title: Loan Balance Rates by Policy Year for Universal Life Insurance Interest Settlements
content:
For Ashgrove Universal Life Insurance policy loans, the annual rate charged on the loan balance carried from the loan interest paid-to date, when loan interest is settled, follows the policy year in which the interest is settled.

## Rate rule

- From the tier's preferred loan first policy year, the tier's preferred loan charged rate applies: **3%** (0.03) on every tier.
- From the interim loan first policy year, policy year **6**, until the preferred loan first policy year, the interim loan charged rate applies: **4.5%** (0.045).
- In earlier policy years, policy years 1 through 5, the tier's standard loan charged rate applies: **5%** (0.05) on every tier.

The tier's preferred loan first policy year is policy year **11** on the Ashgrove Lifetime Guarantee UL, Ashgrove Protection UL, Ashgrove Accumulation UL, Ashgrove Indexed UL Protect and Ashgrove Indexed UL Growth, and policy year **6** on the Ashgrove Indexed UL Premier.

## Rate by tier and policy year

| Policy year of the settlement | Lifetime Guarantee UL, Protection UL, Accumulation UL, Indexed UL Protect, Indexed UL Growth | Indexed UL Premier |
|---|---|---|
| 1 to 5 | 5% | 5% |
| 6 to 10 | 4.5% | 3% |
| 11 and later | 3% | 3% |

On the Ashgrove Indexed UL Premier the preferred loan first policy year and the interim loan first policy year are both policy year 6, so no policy year of that tier falls in the interim band.

## Boundary cases (hypothetical)

Policy year 1 runs from the issue date to the day before the first policy anniversary; policy year 6 begins on the fifth anniversary and policy year 11 on the tenth.

| Tier | Issue date | Settlement date | Policy year | Rate on the balance |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Ashgrove Protection UL | 15 January 2020 | 14 January 2025 | 5 | 5% |
| Ashgrove Protection UL | 15 January 2020 | 15 January 2025 | 6 | 4.5% |
| Ashgrove Protection UL | 15 January 2015 | 15 January 2025 | 11 | 3% |
| Ashgrove Indexed UL Premier | 15 January 2020 | 15 January 2025 | 6 | 3% |
